7 انسدر It (hair, S, M, K, and a curtain or veil, M) hung down; (S, M, K;) a dial. var. of انسدل. (S, K. *) ―
-b2- انسدر يَعْدُو He was somewhat quick, or made some haste, running: (S, M: *) or he went down, or downwards, and persevered (A 'Obeyd, K) in his running, going quickly. (A 'Obeyd.) [In the CK, for يعدو, is put by mistake بَعُدَ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
